steps.name: Explicit evaluation context passed through flag resolution
steps.criteria: A developer can build an EvaluationContext with a targeting key and attributes, resolve a feature with that context, and the flag provider receives the context and resolves accordingly.
steps.scenario_name: Developer resolves a feature with per-user evaluation context

steps.name: Block-scoped context applies to multiple resolve calls
steps.criteria: A developer can wrap multiple resolve calls inside a FlagContext scoped block, and all resolve calls within that block share the same evaluation context.
steps.scenario_name: Developer scopes evaluation context to a block of code

steps.name: Explicit context takes precedence over all other sources
steps.criteria: When explicit context, scoped context, and a context accessor are all active, explicit context wins and the accessor is not consulted.
steps.scenario_name: Explicit context takes precedence over all other context sources

steps.name: Build evaluation context with targeting key and attributes
steps.criteria: EvaluationContext can be built with a targeting key and a map of string attributes; both are retrievable after construction.
steps.scenario_name: Build evaluation context with targeting key and attributes

steps.name: Build evaluation context without targeting key
steps.criteria: EvaluationContext can be built with attributes only; targeting key is absent.
steps.scenario_name: Build evaluation context without targeting key

steps.name: Build evaluation context with targeting key only
steps.criteria: EvaluationContext can be built with a targeting key and no attributes; attributes collection is empty.
steps.scenario_name: Build evaluation context with targeting key only

steps.name: Context attributes collection is never null
steps.criteria: When EvaluationContext is built with no attributes, the attributes collection is empty, never null.
steps.scenario_name: Context attributes collection is never null

steps.name: Explicit context forwarded to flag provider
steps.criteria: When a developer resolves a feature with an explicit evaluation context, the flag provider receives that context and uses its attributes for resolution.
steps.scenario_name: Explicit context is forwarded to flag provider

steps.name: Resolve without context remains backward compatible
steps.criteria: Resolving a feature without an evaluation context behaves identically to pre-context FlagZen.
steps.scenario_name: Resolve without context remains backward compatible

steps.name: Null context treated as no context
steps.criteria: Passing null as evaluation context to resolve is treated as a contextless flag lookup.
steps.scenario_name: Null context is treated as no context

steps.name: Existing flag provider ignores context via default method
steps.criteria: A flag provider that does not implement the context-aware overload ignores context and returns its normal value.
steps.scenario_name: Existing flag provider ignores context via default method

steps.name: Context-aware flag provider uses context for resolution
steps.criteria: A flag provider that implements the context-aware overload uses context attributes to determine the flag value.
steps.scenario_name: Context-aware flag provider uses context for resolution

steps.name: Context-aware flag provider falls back when attribute missing
steps.criteria: When the expected attribute is not present in the context, the context-aware provider falls back to the default variant.
steps.scenario_name: Context-aware flag provider falls back when attribute missing

steps.name: Generated proxy forwards context to flag provider
steps.criteria: The generated proxy passes both the flag key and the evaluation context to the flag provider.
steps.scenario_name: Generated proxy forwards context to flag provider

steps.name: Generated proxy works without context
steps.criteria: The generated proxy can resolve a feature without evaluation context, passing only the flag key to the provider.
steps.scenario_name: Generated proxy works without context

steps.name: Scoped context applies to all resolve calls within block
steps.criteria: All resolve calls inside a FlagContext.run() block receive the scoped evaluation context.
steps.scenario_name: Scoped context applies to all resolve calls within block

steps.name: Context cleared after scoped block exits
steps.criteria: After a scoped context block completes, subsequent resolve calls do not see the scoped context.
steps.scenario_name: Context is cleared after scoped block exits

steps.name: Nested scoped context uses innermost context
steps.criteria: When scoped context blocks are nested, the innermost context is used for resolve calls within the inner block.
steps.scenario_name: Nested scoped context uses innermost context

steps.name: Outer context restored after inner scoped block exits
steps.criteria: After exiting the inner scoped block, resolve calls in the outer block use the outer context.
steps.scenario_name: Outer context restored after inner scoped block exits

steps.name: Scoped context with supplier returns the result
steps.criteria: FlagContext.run() with a supplier block returns the result of the supplier, with the context scoped to the block.
steps.scenario_name: Scoped context with supplier returns the result

steps.name: Exception in scoped block cleans up context
steps.criteria: If an exception is thrown inside a scoped context block, the exception propagates and the context is cleaned up.
steps.scenario_name: Exception in scoped block still cleans up context

steps.name: Null context in scoped block is rejected
steps.criteria: Attempting to run a scoped block with null context is rejected with a clear error message.
steps.scenario_name: Null context in scoped block is rejected

steps.name: Scoped context behavior identical regardless of runtime version
steps.criteria: Scoped context block behavior is identical whether the carrier is ThreadLocal or ScopedValue.
steps.scenario_name: Scoped context behavior is identical regardless of runtime version

steps.name: Each thread sees only its own scoped context
steps.criteria: When multiple threads run scoped context blocks concurrently with different targeting keys, each thread sees only its own context with no cross-thread leakage.
steps.scenario_name: Each thread sees only its own scoped context

steps.name: Context accessor provides context when no explicit context given
steps.criteria: A registered ContextAccessor provides evaluation context when the developer resolves without explicit context.
steps.scenario_name: Context accessor provides context when no explicit context given

steps.name: Lower priority accessor is consulted first
steps.criteria: When multiple context accessors are registered, the one with the lowest priority number is consulted first.
steps.scenario_name: Lower priority accessor is consulted first

steps.name: Accessor returning empty is skipped
steps.criteria: A context accessor returning empty is skipped and the next accessor by priority is consulted.
steps.scenario_name: Accessor returning empty is skipped

steps.name: No accessor registered handled gracefully
steps.criteria: When no context accessors are registered, the accessor step is skipped without error and resolution falls through.
steps.scenario_name: No accessor registered is handled gracefully

steps.name: Explicit context beats all other sources
steps.criteria: When all four context sources are active, explicit context wins.
steps.scenario_name: Explicit context beats all other sources

steps.name: Accessor beats scoped and default when no explicit context
steps.criteria: When no explicit context is given, the context accessor result takes precedence over scoped and default contexts.
steps.scenario_name: Accessor beats scoped and default when no explicit context

steps.name: Scoped context beats default when no explicit or accessor
steps.criteria: When no explicit context or accessor is present, scoped context takes precedence over default context.
steps.scenario_name: Scoped context beats default when no explicit or accessor

steps.name: Default context used as last resort
steps.criteria: When no explicit context, accessor, or scoped context is active, the default context is used.
steps.scenario_name: Default context is used as last resort

steps.name: No context at all preserves pre-context behavior
steps.criteria: When no context source is active at all, the flag provider receives a contextless lookup and resolves normally.
steps.scenario_name: No context at all preserves pre-context behavior

steps.name: Explicit context overrides scoped context within a block
steps.criteria: When explicit context is passed to resolve inside a scoped block, the explicit context overrides the scoped context.
steps.scenario_name: Explicit context overrides scoped context within a block

steps.name: Resolution order is deterministic regardless of registration order
steps.criteria: The resolution order is always: explicit, then accessor, then scoped, then default -- regardless of how or when sources are registered.
steps.scenario_name: Resolution order is deterministic regardless of registration order
